transcription_cross_check: Every Web line was taken from the PDF text layer (PyMuPDF, wraps joined, ligatures written as letters) and checked against 300 dpi renders with 4-6x clips. A scripted cross-check found every transcription line, whitespace-insensitively, in its page's text layer, and every text-layer line of a Web page inside the transcription, except: the printed folios, the LCD map numbers (art), the ® superscripts (separate text-layer runs, read on the render as 「Type-C® and USB-C® are」), the paper TOC (joined as one entry), the outlined in-box and first package-panel labels (read on 300 dpi renders) and micro-text printed inside the p26 package art (manual covers, STS front panel, template). Physical pages 22 and 24 were compared line by line and are identical.

en.caption_text: Warning and Caution Symbols. Must read to alert individuals to potential hazards or risks.
Electric Shock Hazard Symbol for electrical danger warning.
Battery Charging Symbol indicates a battery is being charged.
Explosive Material Symbol for explosion risk warning.
Heavy Object Symbol for handling precautions.
Non-smoking or Open Flame Symbol for fire hazards prevention.
No Children Allowed Symbol for safety risk prevention.
Read the Manual Symbol for safe operation.
